links.note: Was 32727 (What the Chapter Grouped), the summary concept, which says nothing about crucibles. The item asks what a crucible is made of per the Rasaratnasamuchchaya, and no concept in this closed set carries that box: 32716 is Ganga-plains pottery and terracotta, 32726 is the twenty Ayurvedic gunas. Nothing fits, so the link is cleared rather than moved to a neighbour.

Was 32715 (What Counts as a Material), which defines what a material is and cannot be the answer to which property means rough or smooth. Texture is only named in passing in this chapter - among a ball's other properties (32718) and among things to observe while sorting (32719) - and is never defined or used as a grouping property, so no concept in the set is right. 32720 is compression and scratching, not roughness.
